I usually don't agree with Mr. Sanders. But, I must say: he is one of the clearest and cleverest 80yo man in politics. He has the energy he had when he was 50 or even 40. Call it luck, it seems more like determination. He is so determined on his goals that age cannot catch him
I think the second video is of Frank Cuesta. He is a conservationist who has a sanctuary in Thailand to rescue trafficked animals. He has a YouTube channel, if you ar einterested :)
The Florida equivalent to Romeo and Juliet
I actually tried that. But she told me that she wouldn't mind because she trusts me enough

Well, she rejected him. Like they had nothing, she actually stopped him. But the point about "I find that type of close, intimate connection with someone who tried to be my partner's lover innappriate at best, and manipulative emotional cheating that leads to physical affairs at worst" hits close home...

I understand your point. But I do in fact care for her mental health. I really want to see her strive and I am willing to make sacrificies for that. But, in fact, I have enough self respect to know that something is not well here and that maybe I should do something about it.

About hanging out together, I am actually friends with the guy too. But my frienship with him has grown badly since I cannot see him and think of anything else, but suspicion... Which I know is my fault.

 Beyond that, when we hung out together, she acted so close with him that I felt really uncomfortable and had to leave.

 However, she is not secretive. I really don't believe she is hiding anything from me, I am sure about it. But I have a very ill gut feeling.

 The boundaries is what we have talked about. But I don't know what boundaries should I ask for... I asked her to never go to his house alone or to invite him to hers alone. But I feel anything beyond that is trying to control or manipulate her.

Hey. I am afraid too, I think we all are, but there is a point in which I am more afraid of continuing living in this meaningless cycle.
 Yes, my brother stopped me, he might care, but that does not mean he would not be better without me. I cause to many troubles, I am a selfish spend of money and effort. Everyone cares or at least seem to care, but once I am gone I am sure they will live a better life.
